title: start_server params
description: Starts a kamune server. transport is "tcp" (default), "udp", "relay", "p2p", or "direct-p2p"; any other value fails with invalid_transport.

addr.description: Listen address (e.g. "127.0.0.1:9000"). Required for tcp and udp, where an empty addr fails with addr_required; pass "0.0.0.0:0" to listen on every interface.

transport.description: Transport protocol. Defaults to "tcp" when empty or absent. Any other value fails with invalid_transport.

relay_addr.description: Relay server address, host:port with an optional scheme: wss:// (the default), tls://, ws:// or tcp://. A trailing ?insecure=true turns off TLS certificate checks. ws://, tcp:// and ?insecure=true let an on-path attacker read the relay password and tokens, and are logged as a warning. Required when transport is "relay".

name.description: Server display name. Defaults to a fingerprint pseudonym.

broker_addr.description: Broker address for P2P relay. Required for transport "p2p".

peer_pub_b64.description: Base64-encoded public key of a specific peer for static P2P token derivation.
